rina_processing_contract.before_processing: Choose whether to pay that Rina optional self-suspension; validate that exact Tamer can suspend
rina_processing_contract.decline_payment: No Draw and no After evolution, per Q7437
rina_processing_contract.pay_payment: Suspend that Tamer, draw actual next card, expose post-draw own-hand choices, then allow None or one eligible evolution for that effect
rina_processing_contract.draw_then_decline_evolution: LEGAL: Draw is mandatory after successful self-suspension, optional evolution can separately be declined
rina_processing_contract.reductions_do_not_stack: Q7439: two Rina effects resolve separately; never combine their reductions into minus4 on one evolution
rina_processing_contract.effect_has_no_OPT: Availability for a later separate trigger depends on paying own self-suspension and source timing, not invented once-per-turn limit
rina_processing_contract.newly_played_Rina_can_pay_suspension: Being played on turn6 does not prohibit suspending a Tamer as this effect optional condition
rina_processing_contract.card_name_restriction: Evolution target card name must contain Veedramon; the base may be any own Digimon that meets a printed route
rina_processing_contract.phase_and_memory: Effect-authorized evolution is permitted during END_OF_TURN while memory is negative; ordinary Main-action guards must not override that permission
rina_processing_contract.evolution_bonus_draw_and_new_top_When_Di: Required if a non-None legal route is selected; unknown mandatory/optional triggered behavior must precisely HALT rather than be silently omitted or automatically declined.
